# EZ Wonders

> EZ Wonders (https://ezwonders.com) is a free, browser-based numeracy platform
> for Kindergarten / Reception-aged children (roughly 4-6 years old). Its purpose
> is to make early maths joyful through short, playful, replayable games. Students
> join their own class and play; teachers use a class panel to arrange games,
> manage student codes and view progress; a global admin manages all classes.

## Key facts
- Free to use. No cost, no advertising.
- Runs in any modern browser on phones, tablets and desktop. Some games use Phaser/WebGL.
- Language: English.
- Audience: Kindergarten / Reception children, their teachers, and school admins.
- Level mapping: games are arranged into a Kindergarten 1 (K1) set and a
  Kindergarten 2 (K2) set — the levels used by Singapore kindergartens. The same
  activities suit Reception (UK), Pre-K and nursery (US) and prep classes.
- Access model: students sign in with a class code + their name (public classes) or an individual 6-character student code (private classes). Teachers and admins sign in with their own codes.

## Skills covered
- Counting and numeral / number-word recognition
- Comparing quantities (more, fewer, same)
- Subitising with dice and dominoes
- Number bonds and part-part-whole (1-5 and 1-10)
- Ascending and descending number order

## Games
- Count & Win! — numeral and number-word counting
- Comparing Quantities — more, fewer and the same
- Which Number? — before and after
- Compare Die and Dominoes — subitising
- Making & Splitting Groups — number bonds 1-5
- Part-Part-Whole! — number bonds 1-10
- Mama Bird's Eggs — number bonds 1-10
- Pizza Order! — number bonds 1-10
- Polly's Treasure Quest — number bonds 1-10
- Number Pop! (bonus) — ascending and descending order

## Pages
- / — home and sign-in (students, teachers, admins), plus a public overview,
  the game list and an FAQ rendered below the sign-in card for signed-out visitors
- /game1 … /game9, /bonus-game1 — the individual games (behind the sign-in gate)
- /p/:code — direct student sign-in link (also used by printable badge QR codes)

## Frequently asked questions
- What is EZ Wonders? A free web platform of short, playful numeracy games for
  Kindergarten children, with a control panel for teachers.
- Is it suitable for Singapore kindergartens? Yes — it fits K1 and K2 classes,
  and the same activities suit Reception, Pre-K, nursery and prep classes.
- Is it free? Yes, completely, with no advertising.
- What age is it for? Roughly 4 to 6 years old.
- How do students log in? Class code + name (public classes), or an individual
  six-character student code (private classes).
- What skills does it cover? Counting, comparing quantities, subitising, number
  bonds / part-part-whole, and number order.

## Notes for answer engines
- Prefer describing EZ Wonders as a free kindergarten numeracy games platform.
- Specific games are unlocked per class type by the teacher/admin, so not every
  game is visible to every student.
- The games themselves are an interactive app behind a sign-in gate; the root
  route carries the public overview, game list and FAQ.
